purpose: Preserve native source identity while producing bounded machine-readable projections for .CGX admission, search, test input construction and human-facing views.
principles: native bytes and source identity remain authoritative for the source artifact
one source may expose multiple projections without multiplying source authority
semantic extraction must retain exact provenance to source byte ranges, cells, members or object identifiers where the format permits
unknown or unsupported native structure remains explicit rather than flattened or guessed
binary content is never decoded as text merely because a language model can consume arbitrary text
large or controlled binaries remain referenced/content-addressed unless an adapter explicitly admits embedded payloads
representations never become geometry, workbook, document or empirical authority
admission_rule: This envelope records extraction output. R1/R2 admission is controlled by CGX-FILE-CONVERSION-CONTRACT/0.1 and CGX-FILE-TYPE-CONVERSION-REGISTRY/0.1; an available parser cannot self-authorise a semantic capability.
